jobs.description:
We are looking for a versatile CE driver & warehouse worker (M/F/X) to join the team of a well-known employer in Zaventem. In addition to driving the lorry between the two warehouses (distance of approximately 12 kilometres), you will also work as a warehouse worker and be deployed in a multifunctional role.
 

Performing the job correctly contributes to good results and a stronger team. That is why flexibility, eagerness to learn, common sense and stress resistance are essential. Do you have an ETP certificate or a forklift certificate? That is a plus, but not a requirement.

 

• You are stress-resistant, accurate and able to stay focused.

• You are flexible and motivated.

As an AP Accountant based in Merksem, you will play a key role in managing accounts payable processes within the industrial and manufacturing sector. This permanent position involves handling financial transactions and ensuring accuracy in the accounting and finance department.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Omschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

The Sales Support German/English position in the FMCG sector involves managing customer service tasks and assisting the sales team in their daily activities. You will manage two big retailers: Lidl & Aldi.

Client Details

Our client is an FMCG player active in household products and based in Walloon Brabant.

They are looking for a sales support in their KAM team to support the Sales Manager and the sales team for the Retailers Lidl & Aldi.

Description

As a Sales Support German/English your responsibilities are:

• You will coordinate client projects and queries
• You will support the sales team in offers and tenders
• You will support in the launch of commercial actions
• You will do administrative follow up on commercial files
• You will collect, analyze and consolidate commercial information for future purposes
• You will do the overall support of the Key Account Managers in charge of Aldi and Lidl
 

A successful Sales Support German/English should have:

• Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken. French is a plus

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. What are your tasks?

• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)

• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment

• Communicate in English or Romanian

• Possession of a driver's license

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Manager ISS MCMV - EN
jobs.description:
• Lead and optimise Supply Chain processes within the ISS* programme. 

• Manage procurement, inventory, repairable items and physical material flows. 

• Anticipate shortages, delays and risks that could impact vessel availability. 

• Coordinate transport, customs and urgent logistics flows. 

• Monitor suppliers, logistics partners, contracts and performance. 

• Integrate Supply Chain requirements into Procurement, Engineering, Maintenance and Programme Management. 

• Define and monitor KPIs related to availability, inventory, procurement, repairs and supplier performance. 

• Improve processes, data quality and ERP usage across the Supply Chain.  

ISS: In-Service Support

 

• Master’s degree in Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification. 

• At least 5 years of relevant experience in a complex industrial Supply Chain environment. 

• Experience as a Supply Chain Manager, Supply Chain Programme Manager or within ISS/Support is a strong asset. 

• Experience in the naval, defence, aerospace, rail, energy or complex technical systems sector is an advantage. 

• Good knowledge of planning, procurement, inventory management, logistics flows, transport and supplier management. 

• Excellent command of Excel and solid experience with ERP systems and KPI reporting. 

• Professional proficiency in French and English. 

• Strong analytical skills, results-driven and passionate about your field, with the ability to prioritise and respond quickly. 

• Strong leadership skills and the ability to bring together different internal and external stakeholders.

To support our further growth ambitions, Brantsandpatents is looking for an experienced 
(partially qualified) European Patent Attorney 
with a background in life sciences.
 

As a (partially qualified) patent attorney, you will analyze the R&D activities and innovations of your clients and develop an appropriate IP strategy based on this analysis.
 

Within the patent department, you will work with other patent advisors and patent paralegals. In this varied role, you will be responsible for mapping (technical) inventions, drafting patent applications, and managing and guiding the patent portfolios of clients in the broad field of life sciences.
 

You will keep an eye on competing innovations and advise on potential conflicts when necessary. You will also proactively propose solutions. You will represent your clients before the Belgian Intellectual Property Office and the European Patent Office.
 

You'll work from our office in Ghent.

You have or are...
 
 

• A Patent Attorney or Partially Qualified Patent Attorney. 

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in a similar role, preferably in the private sector 

• At least a Masters' degree in life sciences. A PhD is a strong plus. 

• Strong analytical skills and a results-oriented, quality-driven approach. 

• A client-driven mindset. 

• Fluent in Dutch with a good knowledge of English.

International Operations Manager - UK
The International Operations Manager - UK is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the company's overall business operations in the UK market, including retail operations, people management, B2B and B2C sales, marketing, events, inventory, budgeting, compliance and business development.

The role ensures the stable, efficient and compliant operation of the UK business while supporting sustainable sales growth, market development and the expansion of the company's K-beauty activities in line with its European and global strategy.
Key Responsibilities
• Oversee the operation of stores, showrooms, pop-up locations and other offline sales channels in the UK, ensuring operational standards, service quality and customer experience.
• Manage local staffing, including recruitment, onboarding, training, work allocation, scheduling and performance follow-up.
• Develop and implement B2B and B2C sales strategies and identify new distributors, retailers, commercial partners and business opportunities in the UK market.
• Maintain and develop relationships with existing clients, distributors and strategic partners.
• Develop and implement annual and quarterly commercial and marketing plans in coordination with the European organisation and Korean headquarters.
• Plan and execute promotional campaigns, trade fairs, pop-up stores, customer events and partner events, including budget, logistics and performance evaluation.
• Conduct market research and monitor competitors, consumer trends, pricing, distribution developments and K-beauty market opportunities.
• Set sales targets and KPIs, monitor commercial performance and prepare regular management reports and recommendations.
• Analyse sales results, customer feedback and market developments and implement actions to improve business performance.
• Prepare and manage operating budgets, monitor expenses and identify opportunities to improve profitability and cost efficiency.
• Manage sales forecasts, ordering, stock levels, logistics and inventory flow to ensure appropriate product availability.
• Monitor legal, administrative and regulatory requirements applicable to UK operations, including product sales, cosmetics, retail, employment and consumer protection.
• Coordinate with external advisers, service providers, suppliers and relevant authorities and monitor the quality and delivery of their services.
• Identify key operational, commercial and regulatory risks and report significant matters to senior management.
• Work closely with the Korean headquarters, the European entity and other country teams to align UK operations with the company's regional and global strategy.
• Develop and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency, profitability, market presence and long-term business growth.
• Act as the main operational point of coordination for the UK market and support management in strategic and commercial decision-making. Candidate Profile
We are looking for a candidate with strong international business awareness and practical experience who can manage business operations, sales, marketing and K-beauty-related activities in the UK market in an integrated manner.

This position requires continuous communication and coordination between the Korean headquarters and the UK and European teams. The successful candidate should therefore combine a strong understanding of the K-beauty industry with practical capabilities in business development, marketing and operations.
Essential Requirements
• Very high level of Korean proficiency, sufficient to conduct business discussions with the Korean headquarters, prepare reports and documents, and manage day-to-day business communication effectively
• Advanced business English proficiency, sufficient to conduct meetings, negotiations and operational coordination with UK-based employees, clients and business partners
• Proven experience conducting business meetings with English-speaking stakeholders, partners and local employees, including preparing meeting minutes and business reports in English
• Degree or professional education in Economics, Business Administration, Media Technology, Digital Content, Cultural Content or a related field
• Relevant professional experience in marketing, business development, brand management, sales or a related area
• Professional experience in overseas K-beauty markets, including brand marketing, distribution, sales or business development
• Practical experience using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), or relevant certification, with the ability to analyse and report on website traffic, conversions and marketing performance
• Practical understanding of B2B and B2C business models and distribution structures
• Experience planning and managing online and offline marketing campaigns, promotions or events
• Ability to update website content and manage basic website operations
• Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trend analysis and identify new business opportunities
• Ability to analyse sales and marketing data and propose actions to improve business performance
• Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with headquarters, local employees, external partners, suppliers and service providersPreferred Qualifications
• Experience living, studying or working in Korea, with an understanding of Korean business culture and working practices
• Experience in business, marketing, distribution, sales or brand operations in the UK or European market
• Experience participating in K-culture or K-content-related projects, such as international film festivals
• Experience supporting the international expansion, localisation or overseas marketing of Korean brands or Korean consumer products
• Qualification or practical experience in video production or video editing
• Understanding of and practical ability to work with photography, video, social media and digital content
• Experience using CMS or other website management systems
• Proficiency in additional foreign languages beyond Korean and English
• Experience working in multicultural and international business environmentsKey Competencies
The successful candidate should understand the business and cultural differences between Korea and the UK/European markets and be able to effectively adapt the Korean headquarters' business strategy and brand direction to local market conditions.

The candidate should also be able to connect sales, marketing, partner management and business operations through a strong understanding of the K-beauty industry and local consumer market, contributing to market expansion, revenue growth and the stable operation of the company's UK business.

Our client is looking for a Rail Transportation & Logistics Coordinator to ensure the smooth execution of rail transportation activities across Europe. This position offers a unique mix of operational coordination, issue resolution, and performance monitoring within a fast-paced international environment.

Our client is a global market leader operating within complex international supply chains. From a strategic logistics hub in Belgium, the company manages large-scale transportation flows across Europe and continues to invest in the growth of its rail logistics operations.
 

 

 

Omschrijving

• Coordinate and monitor daily rail transportation activities across Europe.
• Manage transport disruptions, delays, and operational escalations.
• Act as the main point of contact between internal stakeholders and external transport partners.
• Monitor wagon availability, utilization, and transport capacity.
• Support sourcing of additional transport capacity when required.
• Prepare operational reports and track logistics KPIs.
• Follow up transport costs, documentation, and invoicing processes.
 

 

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree.

• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable operating in a dynamic international environment.
• Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Drive business growth in the German market by identifying new opportunities, building strong customer relationships, and managing the full sales cycle. Commercial experience is a plus, not a must: motivated juniors with strong German and English skills are welcome to apply for this 100% on-site role in Antwerp.
 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.

This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

 

Omschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.

Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.
 

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Digitribe is looking for a Cloud Project Manager to lead the governance and delivery of a large-scale cloud migration programme at one of our clients, a major player in the financial services sector. You'll be the person who keeps multiple cloud workstreams aligned on plans, budgets, risks and decisions.

You'll join a cloud migration project built around several workstreams: migrations, platform foundations and landing zones. Product Owners define priorities, Solution Architects design the solutions and Change Managers drive adoption. You make sure it all comes together, and you report to programme-level governance.
Your role

• Set up and run the governance of the cloud delivery organisation: cadence, decision forums, controls and accountabilities

• Build and maintain the integrated cloud migration roadmap across all workstreams

• Prepare and facilitate the steering committee, follow up on decisions and escalate when needed

• Track budgets, forecasts, actuals and funding gaps, and trigger corrective actions

• Manage risks, blockers and dependencies across infrastructure, security, architecture, platform teams and external partners

• Deliver clear management reporting and challenge reported status and dates

• Make sure decisions turn into concrete actions and milestones are delivered

• 8+ years in project or programme management within complex IT transformations

• Proven experience running senior steering committees and multi-team governance

• Strong skills in planning, roadmaps, risks and dependency management

• Solid financial follow-up: budgets, forecasts, actuals, Etc

• Experience in financial services or another regulated environment

• Cloud migration experience on Azure

• MSP, PMP, Prince2 or SAFe certifications are a plus

• Fluent English; French and/or Dutch is a plus
